scope: Candidate adapter-level migration contracts, not an implemented migration service.
identity_notes: application/workflow code version is only one component of execution bundle
migration operation identity, workflow run identity, business action identity and external idempotency key are different identifiers
retrying the same semantic external action must not change its identity merely because the adapter build changed

contracts.title: 原始证据与迁移身份
before: Freeze immutable history references and digests, source run/action identities and source/target bundles.
Assign migration_operation_id with namespace, request parameters and outcome lookup; declare whether the chosen operation is idempotent.
after: Append explicit predecessor/successor/migration lineage; preserve original records.
For an uncertain non-idempotent reset receipt, reconcile that same operation before issuing another reset; if no lookup or dedup is available, retain UNKNOWN and assign owner.
contracts.forbidden_inference: A repeated HTTP/CLI request with the same text is safe merely because the earlier response was lost.

contracts.title: 事件表示转换不制造过去
before: Declare source/target event schema and converter version, valid input classes, lossy/unsupported cases.
Preserve raw events separately from the derived read representation.
after: A transformation cannot strengthen UNKNOWN to success/failure without new evidence.
Lossy mapping remains explicit; unsupported shapes stop the affected projection or migration rather than inventing defaults.
Converters are deterministic for the declared inputs; their output retains source references.
contracts.forbidden_inference: A newly required field's default value is an observation that existed in the old event.

contracts.title: 指定历史与执行组合的重放兼容
before: Freeze code, SDK, interpreter, dependencies, codec, workflow/payload schema, plugin and tool semantic profile.
Publish replay history set, patch-marker classes, included/excluded paths and candidate bundle digest.
after: Replay verification and deployed candidate use the declared same bundle; mismatch is not covered.
A replay mismatch prevents automatic continuation of that affected run.
Recorded model output may be consumed as historical input; invoking a model anew is a new attempt and consumes new budget.
observables: replay result by history and bundle
contracts.forbidden_inference: All sampled histories replay, therefore all workflows and future business effects are compatible.

contracts.title: 有限期接管与调度责任
before: Freeze routing policy, permitted admission owner/epoch, source and target control checkpoints, message dispositions and support deadline.
List pending signals/updates/queue items with identities and explicit carry/reapply/exclude decisions.
after: At each observable admission point, stale scheduling authority is rejected according to the declared protocol.
Old requests admitted earlier remain independently tracked; owner change does not establish global absence of old execution.
Deadline infeasibility requires an explicit hold or alternate route with a review date and responsible owner.
observables: routing/admission receipts with profile and epoch
contracts.forbidden_inference: New owner established at an admission point implies at most one process or external request is active anywhere.

contracts.title: 旧请求、迟到证据与副作用身份
before: Freeze semantic action identity, target tenant/account/namespace, canonical payload digest, idempotency-key semantics and retention, effect lookup and termination-proof capabilities.
List all unresolved old requests and conflicting resource obligations.
after: A compatible retry retains the old semantic action and dedup identity within the target's supported contract.
Changed target/parameters or semantic action requires a new authorized action and explicit relation to the old one.
Late evidence attaches to the old action and may change shared-resource admissibility; it cannot overwrite a successor's result.
Without target proof, UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; retries cannot assume the old effect did not happen.
observables: target-scoped effect lookup or synthetic target log
contracts.forbidden_inference: One durable outcome record or a stopped worker proves that the remote effect occurred once or not at all.

contracts.title: 升级不扩大授权
before: Preserve approval/grant target, canonical parameters, operation semantics, scope, expiry and current revocation source.
Specify which changes are approval-material; a build hash change alone need not be material.
after: Future actions are rechecked at their declared execution gate using current authority and explicit clock/freshness inputs.
Changed approval-material parameters cannot inherit the previous approval.
Historical read/replay does not restore revoked authority; replay requiring effects is not treated as read-only replay.
observables: execution-gate decisions and their input versions
contracts.forbidden_inference: A previously approved task or unchanged tool display name authorizes changed future arguments after upgrade.

contracts.title: 索引重建与权限范围
before: Freeze authoritative source references, projection version, coherent watermark/generation and applicable access-control policy.
Declare cross-generation read behavior and current authorization check at retrieval.
after: Publish a coherent index generation with source provenance rather than mixing incompatible generations.
Rebuilding a derived index does not generate business actions or change action outcomes.
Retrieval applies current rights even when the index was built under older permissions; inaccessible evidence is not returned.
observables: access-denied results for scoped test principals
contracts.forbidden_inference: An index snapshot grants access forever or is authoritative proof that a task completed.

contracts.title: 旧版本退役与未决义务交接
before: Declare separate dates for stopping new routing, stopping old workers, removing patch branches/markers, and discarding archived execution artifacts.
Choose observable drainage and outstanding-request evidence; a single eventually consistent empty query is insufficient.
Assign a receiver capable of tracking unresolved effects if old workers retire first.
after: Retirement records show what drained, what was transferred and what remains unknown, with owner and next review deadline.
Patch deprecation/removal respects relevant history classes; archived artifact retention matches agreed recovery/reset window.
A support deadline expiring triggers explicit disposition, not an unsupported claim of compatibility or successful completion.
contracts.forbidden_inference: Old code must run forever, or forced upgrade at the deadline proves safe continuation.

measurement_boundary: Contract adherence and business migration completion are separate measurements. No contract here proves general exactly-once external effects.
